said.speaker: school
said.title: Fall Term 2027 Begins
said.text: Classes run from August 30 to December 10, 2027, when the faculty review the term. Tuition, $21,031.08 a term, is covered by the tuition scholarship. Yale’s aid for living costs goes by need, and your family’s means rule it out, so this term’s Yale Health plan, $2,034.44, was paid from your bank, and living costs are yours.

said.speaker: school
said.title: Cast: Directors’ Thesis Production I
said.text: The chair of Acting has cast you as Vershinin in Three Sisters (Directors’ Thesis Production I), from its first rehearsal call. The lead, Masha, went to Grace Osei. You’ll also understudy Torvald Helmer in Yale Rep’s A Doll’s House: be in New Haven and reachable at every performance. You play the part through the run. Both productions’ calls are on your calendar. A missed call counts against you: two in a term take you out of the casting pool.

said.details:
How The Training Estimates Are Worked Out: Each estimate is your recent work judged again as you are now, with the hours of practice added. It’s what that would be worth a piece, in points of the whole, with the latest piece counting most. For composure, 9 of your last 12 pieces call on it; Heightened Text Scene would gain most, about +0.9. About 0.3 of its estimate comes from the discipline that 20 days of practice build, which any exercise kept up daily would bring too. Set Focus to Steady to start. Spaced pays more once your last session is a day to a week old. It’s an estimate, made only from the work on your record, and the work you do next may call on different things.
What It Assumes Of Your Work: Of your last 12 pieces, 6 were fully prepared, and 6 were underprepared but are counted as fully prepared. In A Voice Sequence, rehearsal stood at 32% of the way to complete. In Sound Changes And A Text, rehearsal stood at 33% of the way to complete. In Heightened Text Scene, rehearsal stood at 69% and work with your partner at 42% of the way to complete. In Heightened Text Scene, revised, rehearsal stood at 88% and work with your partner at 42% of the way to complete. In A Scene From The Greeks, making your choices stood at 56%, rehearsal at 0% and work with your partner at 40% of the way to complete. In A Scene From The Greeks, revised, making your choices stood at 95%, rehearsal at 0% and work with your partner at 40% of the way to complete. The forecast counts those pieces as fully prepared, since their own preparation held each back most. Counted as they were, 20 hours of composure would be worth about 0.59 points a piece, not 1.02. None of them depends on knowing a genre. Apart from training, fully preparing the 6 pieces held back most by their own preparation would bring them about 13.19 points a piece as you are now. That’s preparation, not training, and it isn’t part of composure’s estimate.
Preparation Or Training: Both preparation and training are worth your time now, preparation more: coming to your recent work fully prepared would have added about 13.19 points a piece as you are now (all of it from each piece’s own preparation), and 20 hours of composure would add about 1.02 points a piece.
Other Things Worth Your Time: Work with your partner: Going in short on it cost your recent work about 1.2 points a piece off the whole. Composure, Graded Exposure at the Developing tier: an estimated 1 point a piece for 20 hours, from 50 to about 54. Adaptability, Adjustments at the Developing tier: an estimated 0.6 points a piece for 20 hours, from 53 to about 57. Listening And Responsiveness, The Repetition Exercise at the Developing tier: an estimated 0.5 points a piece for 20 hours, from 64 to about 67.
